data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 昏暗卧榻的水手服解领回眸
data.description: 夜色深沉的公寓卧室内，月光透过单薄的纱帘倾洒在榻榻米上。雪菜端坐在床榻边，身着整洁的彩海学园水手服。纤细玉指轻轻解开领巾与衣领纽扣，露出优美修长的雪颈与精致锁骨。如墨的长发自然披肩，平时认真严谨的剑巫监视者少女，此刻双颊微红，眼含水润光彩，脉脉回首凝视着前方的身影。
data.location: dimly lit private apartment bedroom at night
data.action: sitting on futon with loosened sailor collar and untied necktie, exposed neck and delicate collarbone, long black hair cascading over shoulders, blushing softly, earnest affectionate brown eyes looking at viewer
data.lighting: soft pale moonlight blending with warm bedside lamp glow
data.mood: sacred intimate awakening, sweet earnest surrender
data.promptProse: Sitting on a futon in moonlit silence, Himeragi Yukina wears her Saikai Academy sailor uniform with loosened collar and undone necktie. Her straight black hair cascades past slender collarbones as she turns with an earnest, blushing expression.
data.animaCaption: Yukina loosening her sailor uniform collar on a futon in moonlit bedroom, blushing with sweet devotion.
